summary: Nexalin Technology filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). A prior September 25 Hearings Panel notice granted continued listing on conditions: bid price compliance by September 28 and $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity compliance by January 4, 2027. Shares continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market during the exception period; failure to meet the equity requirement triggers delisting. Watch equity-raise or reverse-split news before the deadline.
